first_pass.summary: A modern bathroom with a light grey marble vanity countertop and an open walk-in shower with grey stone walls and floor.
first_pass.edit_instruction: Surgically replace only the countertop surfaces: the vanity countertop on the left side of the photo, running horizontally above the white cabinet unit with its recessed sink. Keep the existing white cabinet fronts exactly as they are, the recessed undermount sink, the chrome tap and hardware, the light grey marble-look tile walls throughout the bathroom, the open walk-in shower with its grey stone walls and floor in the right half of the photo, the shower fixtures and handheld shower head, the mirrors on the left wall, the beige stone floor tiles, the white ceiling, and the doorway on the far left. first_pass.video_prompt: Generate a first-person walkthrough video starting from this exact bathroom photo showing the new Dekton Trilium vanity countertop. No people, text overlays, or new objects appear in the video. Maintain realistic parallax and geometrically accurate perspective throughout the movement.
